faq_answers.What do I get with Premium?: Advanced analytics, habit templates, cloud backup and sync across devices, premium themes and priority support.
faq_answers.What happens if I miss a day?: Nothing is lost. Your streak pauses, the app suggests a better time, and you pick up again tomorrow.

faq_more.a: Yes. Habits are stored on the device and sync when you are back online.
